span.p:
1. Write the spec
Spec Kit, BMAD or by hand
(with acceptance criteria)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2. Pull request with the spec
reviewed, merged on main

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
4. sdlc spec link INT-… --path … --tool spec-kit | bmad | manual
the platform counts the acceptance criteria

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
G2 passes only with at least
one acceptance criterion

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
5. sdlc plan draft INT-… --from tasks.md --tool spec-kit
a draft on your machine; nothing is sent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
6. A person fills allowed_paths, tools, change_flags
pull request with .sdlc/plans/INT-….yaml, merged
